chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn Ismail who said:

I asked Abu Al-Hassan Al-Reza (peace be upon him) about the man who has a slave girl and kisses her; would she be permissible for his son? He (peace be upon him) said: 'With lust?' I said: 'Yes'. He (peace be upon him) said: 'He has not left anything [unforbidden] when he kissed her with lust.' Then he (peace be upon him) said, initiating the explanation: 'If he exposed her and looked at her with lust, she is prohibited to his father and his son.' I said: 'When he looks at her body?' He (peace be upon him) said: 'When he looks at her private part and her body with lust, she is prohibited to him [the father and son].'
ai.seo_question: What makes a slave girl prohibited for her master's father and son according to Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: Imam al-Rida (AS) clarifies the specific conditions under which a slave girl becomes prohibited (haram) to her master's father and son, distinguishing between general kissing and the more severe act of looking at her private parts with lust. This hadith highlights the Shia juristic emphasis on 'shahwah' (lustful intent) as the decisive factor in establishing these marital prohibitions, reflecting the broader principle that sexual intimacy or its direct precursor creates a barrier to marriage.

en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Muhammad Bin Ismail who said,

‘I asked Abu Al-Hassan Al-Reza<sup>asws</sup> about the man who happened to have the slave girl, so he kissed her. Would she be Permissible for his father?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘With lust?’ I said, ‘Yes’. So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘He has not left anything when he kissed her with lust’. Then he<sup>asws</sup> said initiating him: ‘If he exposed her and looked at her with lust, so she is Prohibited unto his father and his son’. I said, ‘When he looked at her body?’ So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘When he looked at her private part, and her body with lust, she would be prohibited unto him (father and son)’.
en.sarwar: 2. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Muhammad ibn ‘Isma’il who has said the following:

“I once asked al-Rida’, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about the case of a man who had a slave-girl and he kissed her; if she was lawful for his sons. He (the Imam) asked, ‘Was it with lust?’ I replied, ‘Yes, it was with lust.’ He (the Imam) said, ‘He then has left nothing if he has kissed with lust.’ He (the Imam) then initiating said, ‘If he makes her bare and looks at her with lust she becomes unlawful to marry for his father and his son.’ I then asked, ‘What happens if he looks at her body?’ He (the Imam) said, ‘If he looks at her vagina and body with lust she becomes unlawful for him.’”
